text: Maandeeji naange ngen e lewru ndun, e jamma on e ñalorma on, ko Alla elti ɗi. Ɗi haɗtanaa yawtugol ko ɗi eɓɓanaa kon. Wanaa naange ngen woni ko waawi hewtitorgol lewru ndun, waylugol dogudu magge maa naɓugol ndaygu magge, wanaa jemaa on kadi haɗtanaa aditagol ñalorma on, ado o lannude. Ɗi fow majji non, e kala koode e ruugayɗi, ko eltanaaɗi laawi heeriiɗi.
